repairs.feedback:
A reviewer checked it against the person's conditions and found these not met:
- C-005: The automation checks overdue alerts only once a day at 08:00. An alert can go unescalated for about 24 hours, not one. The practice run only shows the email when the condition already holds at run time.
- C-008: The automation hardcodes requester@example.test as the recipient. The user's answer was jordan@corestackit.com, so the email goes to the wrong address.
Fix the workflow so it meets them.

workflow.title: Daily 08:00 unresolved alerts digest to #oncall and hourly critical-unacknowledged escalation to Jordan
workflow.goal: Each hourly run: read the alerts sheet. On the 08:00 UTC run, post a digest of all unresolved alerts (with severity and service) to #oncall. On every run, email jordan@corestackit.com once for each unresolved critical alert that has been unacknowledged for at least one hour and less than two hours (the first run after it crosses one hour).

assumptions: An external scheduler starts this workflow every hour, on the hour (UTC), and passes the current time as input.now in ISO form with a 'T' separator, e.g. 2026-11-04T08:00:00Z.
The 08:00 digest is the run whose input.now contains 'T08:' (UTC).
The Slack stand-in channel is named #oncall.
The escalation recipient is jordan@corestackit.com, as the user answered.
Runs are on the hour, so an alert is escalated at the first run at or after one hour unacknowledged, and never again on later runs because the two-hour window excludes it.
risks: Escalation depends on hourly runs; a missed run means an alert in its one-hour window is not emailed.
An alert acknowledged or resolved after its email is not re-escalated, by design.
If the scheduler's clock is not UTC or runs are not exactly on the hour, the digest gate and age windows can shift.
chat.post and outbox.send are non-idempotent and are attempted only once; a failed send needs manual re-run.
Outbound messages require a person's approval when the flow runs live.
successCriteria: On the 08:00 run, the digest lists every alert with resolved=false, including severity and service, and is posted once to #oncall.
Every critical alert with acknowledged=false, resolved=false and an age of at least 1 hour and less than 2 hours triggers exactly one email to jordan@corestackit.com.
No email is sent when no critical alert is in that window, and no digest is posted outside the 08:00 run.

nodes.description: Keep alerts that are not resolved.
Render one line per unresolved alert with severity and service.
Post the digest to #oncall on the 08:00 run only.
Re-read #oncall and confirm the digest post is there.
Compute hours since each alert was raised.
Keep critical alerts unacknowledged for at least one hour and less than two hours (first hourly run past the threshold, so each is emailed once).
